Picker reasoning effort per-target + 4 model Bynara / Per-target reasoning-effort picker plus 4 Bynara models

2026-09-27 16:17:17featreleasedv0.1.0
ID
2026-09-27-lab-reasoning-effort-bynara
Commit
3620097cec8d54514c80fa7bb2c02cb2b20b0a1f
Summary
ID: Chat Lab mendapat dropdown reasoning effort per-target dan 4 model Bynara reasoning max baru (priority 300-330). / EN: Chat Lab gained a per-target reasoning-effort dropdown and 4 new Bynara reasoning-max models (priority 300-330).

Prior Condition & Problem

ID: Effort reasoning hanya global; model reasoning baru Bynara (agnes-3-flash, longcat-2.5, space-bunny-alpha) belum tersedia di Lab. / EN: Reasoning effort was global-only; new Bynara reasoning models (agnes-3-flash, longcat-2.5, space-bunny-alpha) were not yet available in Lab.

Reason & Motivation

ID: Uji adil antar model reasoning butuh kontrol effort per-target dalam satu run. / EN: Fair comparison across reasoning models needs per-target effort control within one run.

Applied Solution

ID: Field reasoningOverride di runLLMCompletion via applyReasoningOverride (off mematikan semua knob; nilai effort menimpa effort, thinking eksplisit DB tetap menang); migrasi tambah 4 model naraya priority 300-330 applied prod via MCP. / EN: Added a reasoningOverride field in runLLMCompletion via applyReasoningOverride (off disables all knobs; an effort value overrides effort, explicit DB thinking still wins); migration adding 4 naraya models at priority 300-330 applied to prod via MCP.

Affected Files

  • src/components/lab/LabForm.tsx
  • src/lib/lab/actions.ts
  • src/lib/lab/actions.test.ts
  • src/lib/lab/types.ts
  • src/lib/lab/validation.ts
  • src/lib/lab/validation.test.ts
  • src/lib/llm/completion.ts
  • src/lib/llm/completion.test.ts
  • src/messages/id.json
  • src/messages/en.json
  • supabase

Impact

User Impact: ID: Tiap target Lab bisa diset Ikut model/off/low/medium/high/max sebelum submit. / EN: Each Lab target can be set to follow-model/off/low/medium/high/max before submit.

Technical Impact: ID: Kontrak completion + validasi Lab berubah; migrasi DB model LLM (submodule e139a8d). / EN: Lab completion contract plus validation changed; LLM model DB migration (submodule e139a8d).

Validation Evidence

build: not-verified: build outcome not recorded for 3620097 / test: 1173 tests passed (per project memory 2026-09-27) / lint: typecheck passed, eslint passed (per project memory 2026-09-27)

Risks & Limitations

  • ID: Kombinasi effort + thinking eksplisit bisa membingungkan bila keduanya diset. / EN: Combined effort plus explicit thinking can confuse when both are set.

Breaking Changes

    Migration Notes: ID: Migrasi model LLM wajib applied di prod sebelum 4 model dipakai. / EN: The LLM model migration must be applied in prod before using the 4 models.

    Next Steps

    • ID: Deploy Vercel + live verify 4 model baru di /id/lab. / EN: Deploy to Vercel plus live-verify the 4 new models in /id/lab.
